text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: production-inference-high-latency -> paging devon (primary on-call) :rotating_light:

devon: acked, will look. grabbing logs + stack traces now.

maria: FYI seeing a KV cache eviction storm on host pool-12, keys churned ~40k/min. Possible memory pressure.

devon: thanks @maria. starting quick health checks. grep'd latency 95p jumping to ~780ms across gen routes.

jason: any customer-facing errors? status page?

support-bot: Incident detected: svc=inference, symptom=high_token_latency, span=2026-03-15T00:04Z..00:11Z, impacted_customers=["AcmePay", "NimbusHealth"], error_rate=0.7% (spikes to 5% at 00:08Z).

eva: pinged CSMs for AcmePay and NimbusHealth, they've reported slow chat responses. CSM recommends proactive notify if >10min.

devon: running evict command on affected KV shards to force cold-fill as hot keys look corrupted.

devon: ```
# evict keys with high churn on pool-12
python scripts/kv_evict.py --pool pool-12 --threshold 30000 --dry-run=false
```

maria: quick mitigation idea: temporarily route gen requests for long-context models to compatible quantized variant (model-v2-q8) to reduce memory/latency. fallback policy exists in routing rules.

devon: doing canary routing now to 5% of traffic for model-v2-q8. watch latency.

sre-lead: +1 for canary. set alerts for request success rate and tail latency. if canary reduces 95p by >40% we can expand.

devon: canary rollout results (5% -> 25% -> 50%): 95p went 780ms -> 420ms -> 310ms. expanding to 100%.

product-ops: good mitigation. product impact: AcmePay reported chat timeouts on some endpoints, dependent features degrade (payment auth). classify severity as P1-customer-impact.

jason: ok cleanup plan: 1) keep routing to quantized variant 2) identify root cause in KV eviction and fix runbook 3) postmortem + customer comms.

maria: root cause preliminary: aggressive TTL eviction after a config push to cache manager; missing bounds check on computed ttl under certain input shapes. creating a reproduce test.

devon: I pushed a temporary guard in edge routing config to avoid TTL < 60s. rolling out to prod now.

support-bot: Notified impacted CSMs and created ticket S-39821 for customer outreach.

product-ops: Customer comms draft: "We experienced elevated latency affecting some API calls between 00:04–00:18 UTC. We have mitigations in place and are investigating root cause. Support will follow up with impact specifics." Approve? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

jason: approve. send to AcmePay + NimbusHealth. attach sample metrics and ETA for fix.

maria: action items list (quick):
- A1: Fix TTL computation bug in cache manager (owner: maria) — Est: M — Severity: P1 — Q3 reliability backlog
- A2: Improve runbook: KV eviction detection + automated temporary routing (owner: devon) — Est: S — Severity: P2 — Q3 Ops hygiene
- A3: Add chaos test for TTL edge cases in CI (owner: jason) — Est: L — Severity: P2 — Q4 planning
- A4: Postmortem writeup + customer impact table (owner: devon + product-ops) — Est: S — Severity: P1 — schedule this week
- A5: Dashboard + alert tuning for pool-level churn (owner: eva) — Est: M — Severity: P2 — Q3 OKR

devon: will own A2 + co-own A4. setting tasks in remediation board now.

maria: will own A1. ETA target: 3 business days for patch + canary.

jason: taking A3, linking to infra tests. estimate 2 sprints. Q4 tie-in ok.

eva: A5 put into monitoring backlog, tagging as "alert:kv-churn". will provide dashboard link after implementation.

product-ops: scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed Thu 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC — will invite SRE, infra, product, support, and customer success. Owner: devon.

devon: confirmed. I'll own the postmortem. prepping timeline and slices.

tao: oncall handoff in 20m, summary for next on-call:
- incident: production-inference-high-latency
- mitigation: temporary routing to model-v2-q8, TTL guard applied
- open action items: A1..A5 (see board S-39821)
- customer impact: AcmePay + NimbusHealth, outreach initiated

devon: handing off to tao. added runbook notes and links: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kv-eviction

tao: ack, taking over. will monitor scaling behavior overnight.

sre-lead: triage priority for action items: A1 (P1) -> A4 (postmortem/customer comms) -> A2/A5 -> A3. Recommend we slot A1 into sprint next week and mark as +urgent for Q3 reliability workstream.

product-ops: tagging A1 as Q3 reliability priority, will add to quarterly planning board and notify PMs.

devon: closing pager. will update thread with postmortem link when ready. thanks all. :heart:

support-bot: Pager closed by devon at 2026-03-15T00:32Z.

maria: postmortem draft link (WIP): https://redwood-docs/postmortems/1919001234-kv-eviction-ttl.md — please add comments, aim to finalize in 48h.

tao: quick note for next shift: watch pool-12 memory metrics and any regression after TTL patch expands.

devon: last: retrospective ask — prioritization rubric: since customer-impact P1, recommend auto-priority bump into next sprint for fixes that reduce customer-facing risk. tagging ops-queue.

sre-lead: agreed. we'll add policy note to runbooks: auto-escalate P1 customer-impact fixes into nearest sprint unless blocked.

product-ops: thanks team. moving action items into remediation board and adding quarterly tie-in tags.

devon: thread closed.
